pages.title: One job per block
pages.text: Controllers accept power from any face and link by Speaker ID within one dimension.$(br2)Each performs one action.$(br2)The target must already have a sound or playlist for transport actions.

pages.title: Proxy targets
pages.text: Powered playback and Volume can target one proxy by coordinates.$(br2)Its chunk must be loaded.$(br2)Other jobs target the speaker network.

pages.title: Shared inputs
pages.text: Playback inputs combine with OR; volume uses the highest request.$(br2)Duplicate pulses execute once per target per tick.$(br2)Different Speaker IDs remain independent.

pages.title: Conflicting pulses
pages.text: Simultaneous jobs use this priority: Stop, Announcement, Restart, Toggle, Select Track, Next, Previous.$(br2)Equal-priority sources use a stable position-based tie break.

pages.title: Input lifetime
pages.text: Unloading, removal, retargeting or revoked control rights release continuous inputs.$(br2)Removing the last proxy playback controller enables that output; networks retain their transport state.
